text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The day the results of the fan drive are 
announced— The venue is packed with the 
masses who support me. It is the perfect 
way to raise our banner of advance!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And so, I raised the signal flare. To 
conquer the "Golden Generation"! Pledging 
a white-knuckle duel against worthy 
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
First, aim for one of the Classic Triple 
Crown legs. —The Satsuki Sho at lush green 
Nakayama!
